environment.renderer: CPU-only Node VM; no WebGL, GPU, rAF or A51
environment.method: Three rounds in alternating order. Both versions yield one setImmediate event-loop turn after each scenery update. Same positions, heights, original renderable data and quality. Update-work times exclude asynchronous completion callbacks; total process CPU includes native gzip and async completion work on all process threads. Convergence wall times include async waits. Not a browser frame-pacing or physical-device claim.
